title: Jesus is the Original Gospel Warrior and our Commander in Chief
paragraphs: Jesus is the Original Gospel Warrior and our Commander in Chief

They crowned Him with thorns…
But heaven never removed His crown.

They mocked Him like a defeated man…
But hell recognized Him as a conquering King.

Jesus is not just Savior.
He is Commander.
And not the kind who sends others into battle while He stays behind.

No…
He stepped onto the battlefield Himself.
Picture it.

Dust in the air.
Fear in the hearts of men.
Sin gripping humanity like chains no one could break.
And then… He arrives.

Not with an army of swords—
But with truth sharp enough to divide soul and spirit.

Not with political power—
But with authority that makes demons tremble.
This is where most people miss it…
They see the cross as weakness.
Read that again.

They see surrender…
But heaven saw strategy.

Because the war was never against Rome.
It was against sin.
And the breaking point?
It wasn’t the nails.
It was us.

Our rebellion.
Our pride.
Our hidden darkness.
That’s the real battlefield.
And Jesus didn’t come to negotiate with it.
He came to destroy it.
“But here’s what most people don’t realize…”
The cross wasn’t defeat.
It was a calculated strike.

Sin demanded payment.
Justice required blood.
And we had nothing to offer.
So the Commander stepped forward.
Not as a distant general…
But as the sacrifice.
“Originally written by Gospel Warrior”

He took the weight.
He absorbed the wrath.
He paid the debt.
And then—
He walked out of the grave.
Alive.
Victorious.
Untouchable.
This is the Gospel:

You are a sinner.
Not misunderstood—guilty.

But Jesus Christ, the Original Gospel Warrior,
took your place,
paid your penalty,
and offers you grace.

Not earned.
Not deserved.
Received.
By faith.
And now the question shifts.
Not “Is He Commander?”
But…
Are you still resisting His authority?
Because following Jesus is not admiration.
It’s surrender.
If this found you… it’s not by accident.

Spiritual warfare. Identity in Christ. Daily transformation.
Growing almost daily.
Midway reminder—because truth needs reinforcement:
You don’t win this war by trying harder.
You win by trusting the One who already did.
Now here’s where it becomes personal:
Will you keep fighting a battle you already lost…
Or surrender to the Commander who already won?

Repent.
Turn.
Believe.
Follow Him.
